title: An Indian fintech founder now runs the app 3 billion people use to talk to each other.

sources.text: Bloomberg, June 23, 2026 - Meta's Cox Sought Shah's WhatsApp Advice, Then Made Him Leader
TechCrunch, June 22, 2026 - WhatsApp gets new chief as Meta taps India's CRED founder Kunal Shah and invests $900M in startup

caption:
An Indian fintech founder now runs the app 3 billion people use to talk to each other.

On June 22, 2026, Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced Shah would succeed Will Cathcart, who had led WhatsApp since 2019 - making Shah the first Indian to lead the world's largest messaging platform, used by over 3 billion people.

Shah co-founded FreeCharge in 2010, which Snapdeal acquired in 2015 in what was then India's largest startup acquisition. He founded CRED in 2018, scaling it to 17 million members and $325 million in annual revenue. His appointment came alongside a Meta-led $900 million investment in CRED itself.

A Viksit Bharat by 2047 needs proof that building for Indian users at scale is a credential the rest of the world takes seriously. Shah's own market experience is exactly why he's now running the platform for everyone else's, too.
